pairs.target: gé le liǎngrì , fēng zhàn de zǎobān yòu pái dào jì huái .
pairs.english: Two days later Ji Huai was on Wind Trestle's early shift again.
pairs.hanzi: 隔了两日，风栈的早班又排到纪槐。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài xiè jià biān děng tā hé yìnhén , lái de rén què duō dài le yígè qīngnián , jiān zhǎi , shǒu dà , xiān tóngwēn xiù wènhǎo , cái lái zhǎo jìlùbǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi waited by the unloading rack to check wear marks with him, but he brought a narrow-shouldered, large-handed young man who greeted Wenxiu before asking for the recording board.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在卸架边等他核印痕，来的人却多带了一个青年，肩窄，手大，先同温岫问好，才来找记录板。

pairs.target: qīngnián jiào chéng lù , cǐqián zài xià kù diǎn xiāng , jīnhòu měiféng zhè yìbān , tì yuánlái jiān zuò jìlù de gōngrén jiē zhèfèn huó .
pairs.english: The young man was named Cheng Lu; he'd counted crates in the lower store, and now he'd take over the former recorder's extra duty on this shift.
pairs.hanzi: 青年叫成路，此前在下库点箱，今后每逢这一班，替原来兼做记录的工人接这份活。

pairs.target: búshì lái gēn tǎ wéi xué jiè xìng , yě búshì bèi shuí tiāo zhōng jìn xuégōng .
pairs.english: He wasn't here to learn borrowing from Tavi or selected for the academy.
pairs.hanzi: 不是来跟塔维学借性，也不是被谁挑中进学宫。

pairs.target: wēn xiù bǎ bǎn jiāogěi tā , jiào tǎ wéi xiān péi zhe zuò , rìhòu tǎ wéi huíqù shàngkè , zhèlǐ bùnéng děng yì fēngxìnlái cái zhīdào qián yírì nǎlǐ pèng guò mùtou .
pairs.english: Wenxiu handed him the board and told Tavi to work alongside him first: after Tavi went back to classes, they couldn't wait for a letter to identify yesterday's contact with the timber.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫把板交给他，叫塔维先陪着做，日后塔维回去上课，这里不能等一封信来才知道前一日哪里碰过木头。

pairs.target: dìyī xiāng xièxià , tǎ wéi zhǐzhe tuōjià yòubiān nà dào jiù hén , shuō xiān tóng zuórì bǐ , zài jì yǒuméiyǒu xiàng wàizhǎng .
pairs.english: After the first crate, Tavi pointed out an old mark on the cradle's right: compare yesterday, then note whether it had spread outward.
pairs.hanzi: 第一箱卸下，塔维指着托架右边那道旧痕，说先同昨日比，再记有没有向外长。

pairs.target: chéng lù dūn zhe kàn le yízhèn , wèn cóng nǎ yìbiān qǐ suàn yòu .
pairs.english: Cheng Lu crouched to inspect it, asking which side defined right.
pairs.hanzi: 成路蹲着看了一阵，问从哪一边起算右。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèngyào shuō dāngrán shì cháo xiè jiàzhàn de zhèbiān , jiàn tā zhàn zài lìngyìtóu , huà tíng le yíxià , ràoguòqù tóng tā zhàn qí .
pairs.english: Tavi started to say obviously facing the rack, then saw he stood at the other end and moved round beside him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维正要说当然是朝卸架站的这边，见他站在另一头，话停了一下，绕过去同他站齐。

pairs.target: dìèr xiāng lái de shíhòu , chéng lù méiyǒu xiān xiězì , érshì ná zhǐtou zài bǎnbiān diǎn le sānchù , děng xiāngzǐ xiè wěn cái jì .
pairs.english: At the second crate Cheng Lu didn't write first, instead pointing at three places by the board, recording them once the crate was stable.
pairs.hanzi: 第二箱来的时候，成路没有先写字，而是拿指头在板边点了三处，等箱子卸稳才记。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xián zhèyàng huì lòu , jiào tā měi kàn yíchù biàn jì yíchù .
pairs.english: Tavi feared omissions and asked him to write after each observation.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维嫌这样会漏，叫他每看一处便记一处。

pairs.target: chéng lù shuō zìjǐ yǎnjīng gāng cóng jià dǐ yíkāi , zài táitóu jiù rèncuò shàng yíchù , dǎobùrú àn shùnxù kàn wán .
pairs.english: Cheng Lu said looking away from under the cradle made him lose his last place; better to finish looking in sequence.
pairs.hanzi: 成路说自己眼睛刚从架底移开，再抬头就认错上一处，倒不如按顺序看完。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xīnlǐ fājí , pà zìjǐ yì zǒu , zhèxiē rìzi liú de jìlù biàn jiē bú shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi grew anxious: once he left, would all these days' records stop connecting?
pairs.hanzi: 塔维心里发急，怕自己一走，这些日子留的记录便接不上。

pairs.target: tā shuō xiěxià cái suàn liúzhù , chéng lù táiqǐ tóu , wèn zìjǐ gāng jì de sānchù yǒu nǎ chù cuò le .
pairs.english: He said only writing kept things. Cheng Lu looked up: which of his three recorded places was wrong?
pairs.hanzi: 他说写下才算留住，成路抬起头，问自己刚记的三处有哪处错了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi nálái duì , jìng dōu méicuò , zhǐshì huà xiǎodiǎn de shùnxù tóng tā bùtóng .
pairs.english: Tavi checked; none were wrong, only the order of dots differed from his.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿来对，竟都没错，只是画小点的顺序同他不同。

pairs.target: wēn xiù jiào liǎng rén xiān ràngkāi , biéjǐ zhe xièxià yìxiāng .
pairs.english: Wenxiu moved them aside so the next crate could unload.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫叫两人先让开，别挤着卸下一箱。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn dào biānshàng cái fājué , tāmen liǎnggè de zhēngzhí tóng qiánjǐrì cháng liáng kǎ zài péng kǒu shí hěn xiàng , dōu shì zuǐ shuō dé bǐ shǒushàng nà jiàn huó kuài .
pairs.english: Only after standing aside did Tavi realize their argument resembled the beam stuck at the shed a few days ago: mouths faster than the work.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站到边上才发觉，他们两个的争执同前几日长梁卡在棚口时很像，都是嘴说得比手上那件活快。

pairs.target: tā yǒudiǎn bù qíngyuàn dì jiāng bǎn hái huíqù , shuō nà biàn zhào chéng lù zìjǐ de shùnxù , zhǐshì ruò huàn le zhàn de wèizhì , xū xiān biāomíng cóng nǎ tóu kàn .
pairs.english: Reluctantly he returned the board and said Cheng Lu could use his own sequence, but changing position must first mean marking which end he observed from.
pairs.hanzi: 他有点不情愿地将板还回去，说那便照成路自己的顺序，只是若换了站的位置，须先标明从哪头看。

pairs.target: wǔhòu tāmen ná liǎngbiān tuōjià de jìlù yìqǐ hé .
pairs.english: That afternoon they checked both cradles' records together.
pairs.hanzi: 午后他们拿两边托架的记录一起核。

pairs.target: shí bèi xīn zhuǎn lái de nà zhāng yǒu ān míng qiānguò de rìqī , jiù hén méiyǒu wǎng wàizhǎng , lìng yíchù xiāngdǐ máobiān què zhòng le .
pairs.english: Shibei's new sheet had Anming's date and signature. The old mark hadn't spread, but another crate-base splinter had worsened.
pairs.hanzi: 石背新转来的那张有安茗签过的日期，旧痕没有往外长，另一处箱底毛边却重了。

pairs.target: chéng lù xiān zhǐ nà chù , wèn shìbushì yào tíng zhè yìxiāng .
pairs.english: Cheng Lu pointed to it first: stop this crate?
pairs.hanzi: 成路先指那处，问是不是要停这一箱。

pairs.target: wēn xiù kànguò , ràng nà zhī xiāng lìng fàngdào dài cháchǔ , bù yīn pángbiān jǐzhī tóngyàng chǐcùn biàn yìqí fàngxíng ; qíyú zhào yǐ hé guò de xiāngdǐ jìxù , méi jiào zhěnggè huòchǎng péi tā yìqǐ tíng .
pairs.english: Wenxiu inspected and set it aside for checking. Other crates with the same dimensions weren't automatically cleared; verified bases continued without stopping the entire freight yard.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫看过，让那只箱另放到待查处，不因旁边几只同样尺寸便一齐放行；其余照已核过的箱底继续，没叫整个货场陪它一起停。

pairs.target: chéng lù jiāng nà zhī xiāng de jìhào huà le liǎngbiàn , yíbiàn zài xiāng dān páng , yíbiàn zài zànfàng de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Cheng Lu drew the suspect crate's mark twice, on its order and its temporary location.
pairs.hanzi: 成路将那只箱的记号画了两遍，一遍在箱单旁，一遍在暂放的位置。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèhuí méiyǒu jiào tā shǎo huà .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't ask him to draw less this time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这回没有叫他少画。

pairs.target: liǎng rén dào rìtou piānxià shí cái shōu bǎn , qīngnián wèn tā huí xuégōng hòu shìbushì búyòng zài bāndōngxī .
pairs.english: They finished the board late in the day. Would Tavi no longer carry things at the academy, the young man asked.
pairs.hanzi: 两人到日头偏下时才收板，青年问他回学宫后是不是不用再搬东西。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng le yíhuìer , shuō zài xuégōng sìhū yě méi shǎo bān . "
pairs.english: Thinking a while, Tavi said he seemed to carry plenty there too.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维想了一会儿，说在学宫似乎也没少搬。
“

pairs.target: nà jiùshì huàn gè dìfāng xiě ? "
pairs.english: “So, writing in a different place?”
pairs.hanzi: 那就是换个地方写？”

pairs.target: chéng lù wèn .
pairs.english: Cheng Lu asked.
pairs.hanzi: 成路问。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běnlái xiǎng jiǎngkè shàng de zhǒngzhǒng , hūrán xiào qǐlái , shuō yě bùquánshì .
pairs.english: Tavi meant to explain classes, then laughed and said not entirely.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本来想讲课上的种种，忽然笑起来，说也不全是。

pairs.target: tā cóng bāo lǐ náchū zǎoxiān liàn guò de yídào suànshì , cái zhǎnkāi yíbàn , chéng lù yǐjīng jiàokǔ , shuō zìjǐ zhǐshì wèn yíjù , méi wèn tā tǎo tí zuò .
pairs.english: He took an old practice calculation from his bag, barely unfolding it before Cheng Lu protested: just a question, not a request for homework from him.
pairs.hanzi: 他从包里拿出早先练过的一道算式，才展开一半，成路已经叫苦，说自己只是问一句，没问他讨题做。

pairs.target: jì huái zài pángbiān xiào dé quē zhe de nà kē yá dōu kàndéqīng , jiào tǎ wéi kuài shōu , bùrán xià yìbān yòu dé zìjǐ jì .
pairs.english: Ji Huai laughed, his missing tooth showing, and told Tavi to put it away or he would have to record the next shift himself again.
pairs.hanzi: 纪槐在旁边笑得缺着的那颗牙都看得清，叫塔维快收，不然下一班又得自己记。

pairs.target: wǎnshàng , tǎ wéi jiāng jīnrì jiāojiē xiě jìn bàogào .
pairs.english: That evening Tavi put the handover in his report.
pairs.hanzi: 晚上，塔维将今日交接写进报告。

pairs.target: xiě dào chéng lù nà yìlán , tā xiān xiě néng àn shùnxù hé sānchù , hòumiàn tiān le yíjù , zìjǐ zuìchū cuī dé tài jí .
pairs.english: Beside Cheng Lu he first wrote that he could check three places in order, adding that he'd hurried him too much at first.
pairs.hanzi: 写到成路那一栏，他先写能按顺序核三处，后面添了一句，自己最初催得太急。

pairs.target: zhǐ shàng zhè jù huà méi bǐ biéchù nán xiě duōshǎo , luòxià yǐhòu , tā dǎo kàn le hěn jiǔ .
pairs.english: That sentence wasn't much harder to write than the others; afterwards, though, he looked at it a long time.
pairs.hanzi: 纸上这句话没比别处难写多少，落下以后，他倒看了很久。
